title: Spec: Event payloads and Beads mode guard
description:
As a Kanbus user reviewing event history, I want agent metadata captured in event payloads, and I want Beads mode to fail clearly rather than silently drop provenance.

## Gherkin

```gherkin
Feature: Agent metadata events and Beads guard
  As a Kanbus user
  I want agent provenance in the audit trail
  So that timeline views reflect AI attribution

  Scenario: Issue created event includes agent when present
    Given a Kanbus project with default configuration
    When I create issue "kanbus-ev" with agent platform "cursor" model "composer-2.5"
    Then the latest event for "kanbus-ev" should include agent platform "cursor"

  Scenario: Comment added event includes agent when present
    Given an issue "kanbus-aaa" exists
    When I add comment "Note" on "kanbus-aaa" with agent platform "codex" model "gpt-5"
    Then the latest comment_added event for "kanbus-aaa" should include agent platform "codex"

  Scenario: Beads mode rejects agent flags on create
    Given a Kanbus project in beads compatibility mode
    When I run "kanbus create \"Task\" --type task --agent-platform cursor --agent-model x"
    Then stderr should contain "agent metadata requires native Kanbus issue storage"

  Scenario: Beads mode rejects agent flags on comment
    Given a Kanbus project in beads compatibility mode
    And an issue "kanbus-aaa" exists
    When I run "kanbus comment kanbus-aaa \"Note\" --agent-platform cursor"
    Then stderr should contain "agent metadata requires native Kanbus issue storage"
```

## Implementation notes

- Extend `issue_created_payload` and `comment_payload` in Python and Rust event_history modules
- Do not emit `field_updated` for issue agent (immutable after create)
- Beads guard at CLI entry before beads_write paths
